insights.one_liner: Openclaims is a 25-person Amsterdam SaaS company for car damage repair management, posting English-language software roles for juniors and interns.

culture.text: About 25 people in Amsterdam, founded in 2015, building software for insurers, fleets and the automotive sector.
Staff mostly come from the University of Amsterdam, Erasmus, VU Amsterdam and Groningen, in economics, business and computer science.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.

worth_knowing.text: Describes itself as an award-winning provider of digital repair management for motor insurance.
